readme: Decision
Illustrative $100M direct growth equity investment in Vanta vs Chainguard.
Purpose
Determine whether either company clears an analyst-selected 20% 5-year gross IRR threshold and price accordingly.
Not a TVG return target
The 20% hurdle is explicitly an analyst assumption, NOT a disclosed OTPP/TVG requirement.
Not a live offer
Transaction prices are hypothetical and do not imply shares or allocations are accessible.
Economics
ARR snapshots are not GAAP revenues; revenue and FCF forecasts are illustrative proxies.
Public gaps
No cap tables, cohorts, accounting financials, net debt, liquidation preferences, taxes or access have been verified.
Model layout
Sources -> Historical Inputs -> Assumptions -> Forecasts -> Returns -> Valuation Matrix -> Dashboard -> QA.
Blue numbers
Hardcoded sourced numeric inputs and editable analyst assumptions; monetary inputs in USD millions.
Green numbers
Formulas pulling directly from another sheet.
Black numbers
Same-sheet calculations and derived financial values.
Yellow
Assumptions and sourced financial inputs; editable, with data provenance.
Formula policy
No hardcoded derived financial outputs in worksheet cells.
Scope exclusions
No liquidation waterfall, preferred conversion rights, participating prefs, currency hedging or fees.
Primary vs secondary
Primary investors receive newly issued equity; secondary purchases transfer existing shares.
Dilution
A separate cumulative ownership-retention assumption applies after entry through exit.
Exit net debt
Net debt or net cash at exit are analyst scenario assumptions, not reported company amounts.
Read with memo
Investment conclusion is conditional; this is not a recommendation to transact without actual diligence.
historicalCautions: Caution: Historical valuation and ARR dates do not match. Never claim dividing them is a priced transaction multiple.
No verified 2026 cap table, gross margin, retention, net cash, preferred stack, or debt terms available publicly.
assumptionNotes: Source quality: all scenario growth, margin, multiples, debt adjustments and transaction values are analyst-created assumptions.
Exit net debt is not the disclosed $280M growth financing. Terms and outstanding claims must be diligence-verified.
returnsNotes: Deal pricing is modeled, not confirmed. No seller availability, financing terms, preferred liquidation stack, options or warrants verified.
Return outputs are GROSS, before fees, taxes, FX, and fund-level economics. No TVG-specific hurdle is asserted.
Chainguard's $280M 2025 financing is not assumed to equal outstanding exit net debt.
dashboardNarrative: No hypothetical $100M primary investment at the modeled pre-money prices clears the illustrative 20% gross IRR threshold in the base case.
Vanta: move to diligence only if price approaches the model-derived maximum or new evidence strengthens underwriting.
Chainguard: selectively diligence product advantage and enterprise pricing under pressure from Docker free tier.
No pricing access, confirmed current valuations, financial data room, fully diluted capitalization or liquidity terms were obtained.
The two 2026 ARR anchors differ materially in quality: Vanta company disclosure vs Chainguard Sacra estimate.
TVG writes $50-$250M initial checks (S01), which makes transaction-level pricing, rights and scenario return sensitivity essential.
notes.disclaimer: Analyst-author disclaimer: independently produced case study; no affiliation with OTPP, Vanta, or Chainguard.
